name: turbojet_ideal_260ms
title: Ideal turbojet flying at 260 m/s
summary: Air-standard jet-propulsion cycle of an ideal turbojet: isentropic diffuser, compressor (pressure ratio 10), isobaric combustor (turbine inlet 1100 °C), turbine driving only the compressor, isentropic nozzle back to ambient; exhaust velocity and propulsion efficiency.

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (40 variables, kPa/kJ converted by compare_solution.py --ees-units)
verification.notes: The 12 differing variables are the absolute h[i]/s[i]: constant EES-vs-CoolProp reference-state offsets (+126.06 kJ/kg on h, -2978.2 J/(kg-K) on s). All other variables agree within 2.6e-05 (T[2]); eta_P within 2.3e-06. The 'only in CoolSolve' variable is pi_c, introduced at the import.
